name: section-data
body: The authored section tree exposed to a layout as data under the reserved `.data` context, parallel to the rendered-HTML list for each declared section: `.data.<section>` is a source-ordered list of instance data, each carrying `.raw` (original source field values), `.item` (its sibling descriptor) and `.data` (its own child sections). A data value, not a helper. A section invoked by the `section` helper is a render call, not an authored instance, so it is not part of the caller's `.data`.
